name: rpgwright
description: A Playwright-like end-to-end testing framework for real-TTY terminal applications (Ink/React CLI apps, RPG/MUD-style text adventures, and anything else that depends on raw-mode PTY behavior).

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: node bin/rpgwright.js test --config test/rpg/minimal/rpgwright.config.js && node bin/rpgwright.js test --config test/rpg/menu-nav/rpgwright.config.js
